title: 'El Señor de la T,' CJNG Regional Coordinator for Bajío Michoacán, Arrested
detail: On September 17, 2026, Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch announced the arrest of Manuel Alejandro Rendón Aguilar, 51, alias 'El Señor de la T,' in a joint operation by the SSPC, SEDENA, SEMAR, the FGR and the Michoacán state prosecutor's office. Authorities identified him as an alleged CJNG regional coordinator operating across the Bajío michoacano municipalities of Angamacutiro, Penjamillo, Panindícuaro, José Sixto Verduzco and Puruándiro, with a close operational relationship to fellow regional CJNG commander Heraclio Guerrero Martínez, alias 'Tío Lako.' He faced active arrest warrants for homicide and forced disappearance, plus charges of extortion, kidnapping, drug retail distribution and organized crime, and was linked by prosecutors to the 2025 killing of Penjamillo síndico Roberto Ramírez Zárate and the disappearance of former Angamacutiro mayor Maribel Juárez Blanquet.

media.caption: Manuel Alejandro Rendón Aguilar, 'El Señor de la T,' announced as detained by Security Secretary Omar García Harfuch

confidenceReason: The arrest, charges and Tío Lako operational link are confirmed by Security Secretary García Harfuch and corroborated by two independent Tier-2 outlets; his precise CJNG rank and role in the cited homicide/disappearance cases remain a prosecutorial allegation pending trial.
